main.description: A community with its member count. With service auth for the indexer (the gate service DID), also the caller's membership state, checked on-chain or with Krao's verification for 'condition' and 'verified' communities. Without auth, no viewer state. Rate limited.

feedGeneratorDid.description: The DID a community feed generator record (app.bsky.feed.generator, rkey community-<slug>) must name to be served: the indexer's feed generator DID. Absent when the indexer serves no feeds.
